_설명: tools/gen_art.py가 읽는 프롬프트 모음. 영어 프롬프트가 이미지 모델에서 더 안정적이라 프롬프트는 영어, 설명은 한국어로 쓴다. 바꾸면 WORKLOG에 이유를 남긴다.
style: Cute 2D cartoon game sprite for a cozy forest lane-defense game. Chibi proportions (big head, small body), thick dark-brown outline (#4A3220) of even width, soft two-tone cel shading, bright warm forest palette, clean flat colors, no texture noise, no text, no ground shadow, no background scenery.
background: Fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). If transparency is impossible, use a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, no vignette and no shadow.

fox.name: 여우
fox.description: A white fox, the hero shooter of the forest. Sitting upright in side 3/4 view facing RIGHT. Pure white fur with light-gray shading, cream-colored chest, cheeks and muzzle, pink inner ears, light-gray ear tips, a big fluffy white tail curling behind with a cream tip, shiny black eyes with a white highlight, small black nose, gentle confident smile. Front paws slightly raised, ready to toss a small warm orange-gold fox-fire flame.

squirrel.name: 다람쥐
squirrel.description: A chubby orange-brown squirrel with a cream belly and a big curly tail, hugging a shiny acorn, side 3/4 view facing RIGHT.

turtle.name: 거북이
turtle.description: A sturdy green turtle with a big domed moss-green shell with honeycomb plates, determined eyes, side 3/4 view facing RIGHT, bracing to block.

skunk.name: 스컨크
skunk.description: A black-and-white skunk with a huge raised striped tail and a mischievous grin, side 3/4 view facing RIGHT.

slime.name: 슬라임
slime.description: A round jelly-green slime blob with a glossy highlight, two big dot eyes and a small hungry mouth, side 3/4 view facing LEFT.

slime_helmet.name: 투구 슬라임
slime_helmet.description: The same jelly-green slime blob wearing an oversized brown acorn-cap as a helmet, side 3/4 view facing LEFT.

wisp.name: 도깨비불
wisp.description: A small floating purple will-o'-the-wisp spirit, teardrop-shaped flame body with a wispy tail, two cute eyes, side 3/4 view facing LEFT.

idle.prompt: Idle breathing loop: body gently rises and falls, tail sways slowly, one ear twitches once. Frame 8 must flow back into frame 1.

attack.prompt: Throw attack: crouch back to anticipate (frames 1-3), lunge forward with front paws flinging a small orange-gold fox-fire flame to the RIGHT (frame 5 is the release, the flame just leaving the paws), then settle back to the idle pose (frames 6-8).

hit.prompt: Hurt reaction: flinch backward to the LEFT with squinted eyes and flattened ears (frames 1-2), then recover to the idle pose (frames 3-4).

death.prompt: Defeat: wobble, dizzy swirl eyes, slowly tip over onto its side and lie still with the tail flopping down. No blood, cute and gentle.
